cohort: The study included 6,648,883 women who delivered 6,925,920 infants from the National Inpatient Sample dataset.
finding: Chorioamnionitis is associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery, and ethnic disparities in CD rates exist regardless of chorioamnionitis status.
mod_finding: Chorioamnionitis is associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery, and African American women experience significantly higher CD rates even after controlling for chorioamnionitis.
